method: 500 conversations and 200,000 messages in a 28 MB database with the production indexes; warmed 100-iteration timings per setting
note: 32 MiB page cache gives ~6x on conversation-list queries at this scale; mmap gives a similar result but maps the file into RSS, and temp_store=MEMORY was slightly worse. Small databases only cache pages they touch, so the ceiling does not imply 32 MiB RSS on day one.
